reason: 21,000 dinars in fees on a 30,000 item leaves me nothing to resell it for, and I can walk into Shorja and find something close for less today without waiting three weeks. For my shop the numbers just don't work.
objection: The shipping per kilo eats the whole margin, and I already have agents and wholesalers who bring goods from China cheaper in bulk.
would_change_my_mind: A bulk or reseller rate, with shipping well under 13,000 per kilo and a lower buying fee on bigger orders, so I can buy ten pieces and still make a profit.
